query:
-- Atualizar tabela lessons com tipo de aula
ALTER TABLE lessons ADD COLUMN lesson_type ENUM('lexical', 'communicative') DEFAULT 'lexical';
ALTER TABLE lessons ADD COLUMN topic VARCHAR(255);

-- Tabela de diálogos (Before Class)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lesson_dialogues (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  lesson_id INT NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  audio_url VARCHAR(512),
  order_index INT DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Tabela de linhas de diálogo
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dialogue_lines (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  dialogue_id INT NOT NULL,
  speaker VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  text_en TEXT NOT NULL,
  text_pt TEXT,
  audio_url VARCHAR(512),
  order_index INT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Tabela de atividades de comunicação (Before Class - Comunicativa)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lesson_activities (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  lesson_id INT NOT NULL,
  activity_type ENUM('role_play', 'discussion', 'describe', 'listening', 'speaking', 'writing') NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  instructions TEXT,
  content JSON,
  order_index INT DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Tabela de exercícios de consolidação (After Class)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lesson_consolidation_exercises (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  lesson_id INT NOT NULL,
  exercise_type ENUM('fill_blanks', 'match_columns', 'translation', 'multiple_choice', 'listening', 'speaking', 'writing') NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  instructions TEXT,
  content JSON NOT NULL,
  answer_key JSON,
  order_index INT DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
